_doc: skill_level_requirement is extracted from PoB (char level needed for gem level N, index N-1). Everything else here is curated by hand; see sources.
skill_tier_rule: A skill/spirit gem of Tier T can only be engraved from an Uncut Skill/Spirit Gem of level >= T, and the engraved gem has the uncut gem's level, so it needs character level skill_level_requirement[T-1] (e.g. Barrage: Tier 5 -> gem level 5 -> requires level 14, poe2db Barrage level table). Tier 0 = not obtainable from uncut gems (granted by items/ascendancy/tree, lineage) -> not planned, except tier-0 weapon skills (granted by the weapon, level 1).
support_tier_note: ESTIMATE. Support tier T needs an Uncut Support Gem of level >= T; drop level per tier is not confirmed for 0.5. poe2wiki (3-tier era): lvl1 drops at 1-34, lvl2 35-52, lvl3 53+; outof.games lists Uncut Support Gem (Level 4) drop level 45. Interpolated to 5 tiers; quest/vendor rewards can give supports earlier.
support_slots_note: HEURISTIC cap on support gems planned per skill group (cut skill gems start with few support sockets; Jeweller's Orbs add more). Not data-backed.
sources: https://poe2wiki.net/wiki/Uncut_gem (drop level breakpoints, search snippet; page blocked for bots)
https://poe2db.tw/us/Uncut_Skill_Gem (engraves a gem / levels it to the uncut gem's level)
support_rule: Support gems have no character level requirement (poe2db: Requires Level 0); only the uncut support gem level (= tier) gates them, see support_tier_min_char_level (estimate).
barrage_check: 2026-10-24: Travic gets Barrage from the level-5 Uncut Skill Gem after the Executioner. poe2db: The Executioner is in Ogham Village (G1_13_2, area level 13), so the gem arrives at char ~13 and a level-5 Barrage is usable from 14. Planner says 14: consistent, rule unchanged.
